text:
Liam: Hi finance, weird corpcard charge at SFO lounge today. Terminal printed $45.00 but card shows $55.00 posted. No itemized receipt, just a terminal slip. Need to file expense.
JESS: @Liam can you upload the photo of the terminal slip to Expensify? If there's no itemized VAT-style receipt we may need a manager attestation.
Liam: Uploaded photo to Expensify, it only shows a generic "LOUNGE ACCESS" line and a merchant descriptor LOUNGEHOUSE*SF. There is a second line that says "Service Fee: $10" but no breakdown.
Financebot: Reminder: corpcard disputes must be opened within 60 days. Run `finance corpcard dispute --tx 1787654321` if the merchant mischarged. For processing, we need either an itemized receipt or manager sign-off for approximate amount.
Nina: I approved the lounge expense for Liam while traveling for client onboarding. I confirm the $55 is business. Posting here so finance has written manager approval.
JESS: Thanks @Nina. With the manager approval and the uploaded terminal slip we'll code the full $55 to travel:lodging/amenities. If dispute is opened and successful, we'll adjust. Liam: set the Expensify claim to $55 and tag with this thread.
